name: actools/actools_bs5
description: Actools BS5: a standalone Bootstrap 5 theme for Drupal, built with SASS and Single Directory Components, adapted from the Varbase theme by Vardot.

suggest.drupal/canvas: Optional visual editor; this standalone build does not supply Canvas-specific media widgets and requires separate integration testing.
suggest.drupal/cva: Optional class-variance-authority helper for the component source build tooling.
